newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power falls on mild weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power falls on mild weather.

text.p: Spot bulk electricity prices in the U.S. Mid-Atlantic fell Tuesday from recent highs on outlook of mild weather moving into the region.

"The bids are backing off," said a Mid-Atlantic trader. "They pretty much covered everything," he added, referring to the buyers who rallied daily prices in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect pool on Friday and Monday.

Despite the ongoing outages of the 610 megawatt (MW) Oyster Creek nuclear power station in Forked River, N.J. and 1,031 MW Hope Creek nuclear plant in Salem, N.J., spot prices in PJM were pushed lower on expected lower power demand in the next couple of days, brokers and marketers said.

The Oyster Creek plant, operated by GPU Nuclear, was heard planned to resume service Wednesday, and Hope Creek was scheduled to return this weekend following repairs to valves in its recirculating system.
Transmission constraint from western and eastern PJM due to reduced operation at the fire-damaged Whitpain substation, north of Philadelphia, was less of a concern today, they said.

Firm, peak PJM electricity for Wednesday was mostly sold today in the $24.00-$25.00 a megawatt hour (MWh) range, with unconfirmed deals heard done as low as $23.75. Today's values compared with Monday's $26.50-$28.50.
Firm, off-peak PJM power for next-day delivery was notationally assessed near $14.00, down from Monday's quote of $16.00-$18.00.
PJM deliveries for the rest of the week was talked at $24.50-$25.50, lower than Monday's $26.00-$27.00.
For the balance of November, PJM electricity for firm, peak delivery was assessed at $24.25-$24.75, off from a range of $25.00-$26.00 on Monday.
December PJM power with similar delivery conditions was discussed between $28.10 and $28.50, down from Monday's range of $28.50-$28.75.
January/February 1997 PJM deliveries were pegged at $31.90-$32.30, down from $32.50-$32.75 on Monday.
March 1997 PJM electricity was valued at $24.25-$24.75, lower than Monday's $24.50-$25.00.
